traverses.name: Perseverance (Mars 2020)
traverses.highlights: 42.71 km traverse exploring Jezero Western Fan Delta and collecting 20 sealed rock cores for Mars Sample Return.

traverses.name: Curiosity (MSL)
traverses.highlights: 33.28 km climb up Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons), discovering ancient habitable lakebed sediments and organic molecules.

traverses.name: Opportunity (MER-B)
traverses.source: NASA / JPL-Caltech / MER Science Team · Analyst's Notebook (WUSTL PDS)
traverses.highlights: Longest off-world drive in history (45.16 km). Navigated Eagle, Endurance, Victoria, and Endeavour craters across Meridiani Planum.

traverses.name: Spirit (MER-A)
traverses.source: NASA / JPL-Caltech / MER Science Team · Analyst's Notebook (WUSTL PDS)
traverses.highlights: Explored Gusev Crater, ascended Husband Hill (107 m summit climb), and discovered pure opaline silica hot springs at Home Plate.

traverses.name: Mars Pathfinder / Sojourner
traverses.source: NASA / JPL-Caltech Mars Pathfinder Science Team (PDS Moore et al. 1999)
traverses.highlights: Historic first wheeled rover on Mars (1997). Traversed 105 m around Carl Sagan Memorial Station, analyzing Yogi, Barnacle Bill, and Mermaid Dune.
